summary: Session-scoring gate: returns TRUE only while the global dword_7D2E44 is zero and SessionStateCheck on the session state object at dword_7CD25C does not return 1. A non-zero dword_7D2E44 short-circuits the whole check to FALSE without consulting the session state. Reused as a shared 'is scoring allowed to proceed' predicate across configuration validation, restart, player file init, AI driver count setup, season scoring and telemetry callers.

operations.description: Read dword_7D2E44; when non-zero the gate closes immediately (expression is false) without evaluating the session state.
Invoke SessionStateCheck on the session state object located at dword_7CD25C and test whether its returned state is not equal to 1.
Return the conjunction: the gate passes only when dword_7D2E44 is zero and SessionStateCheck(&dword_7CD25C) differs from 1.

unresolved: The meaning of dword_7D2E44 (zero while the gate is open) and of the SessionStateCheck result value 1 (the state that blocks the gate) are not defined by this packet.

Callers span divergent contexts (config validation, restart, player file init, AI driver count setup, season scoring, telemetry dump); the same predicate answers 'may scoring proceed' for each without per-caller qualification, so the triggering state value 1 is not pinned down here.
